name: patient_has_suspicion_of_acute_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has appendicitis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_appendicitis_now@@suspected_or_confirmed_perforated
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's appendicitis is suspected or confirmed to be perforated.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has appendicitis and the appendicitis is suspected or confirmed to be perforated.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has appendicitis but it is not suspected or confirmed to be perforated.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's appendicitis is suspected or confirmed to be perforated.
